name: wal_format
description: Write-Ahead Log (WAL) binary file header and frame layout definitions for WebDB
criticalWarning: CRITICAL WARNING: FROZEN WAL BINARY FORMAT SPECIFICATION
DO NOT modify the order, types, or byte lengths of existing fields in
WalFileHeader or WalFrameHeader! Changing any offset or field size breaks
binary determinism, prevents crash recovery, and corrupts WAL logs.
Both the WAL file header (32 bytes) and WAL frame headers (32 bytes)

constants.name: WAL_PAGE_SIZE
constants.description: Rigid page payload size in bytes per WAL frame (4096 bytes).

constants.name: WAL_FRAME_SIZE
constants.description: Total size in bytes of a single WAL frame (32-byte header + 4096-byte page payload = 4128 bytes).

constants.name: WAL_FRAME_MAGIC
constants.description: Magic number for WAL frames (0x57414C46 in uint32 LE = 'WALF').

constants.name: WAL_FRAME_TYPE_PAGE_DATA
constants.description: Frame type 0x0001: Committed 4KB page mutation for page_id.

constants.name: WAL_FRAME_TYPE_TX_COMMIT
constants.description: Frame type 0x0002: Commit marker for tx_id. Signals that all preceding frames for this tx_id are permanently committed.

constants.name: WAL_FRAME_TYPE_TX_UNCOMMITTED
constants.description: Frame type 0x0003: Cache spill frame under memory pressure. Ignored during recovery unless followed by a commit marker.

layouts.sizeDescription: Total size in bytes of the WAL file header (32 bytes).

fields.name: WAL_VERSION
fields.description: 6..7: WAL format version (1 for V1, uint16 LE)

fields.name: SALT1
fields.description: 16..19: Random salt generated on checkpoint (uint32 LE)

layouts.sizeDescription: Total size in bytes of a single WAL frame header (32 bytes).

fields.name: PAGE_ID
fields.description: 12..15: Target database Page ID (1..N, uint32 LE)

fields.name: DB_SIZE_PAGES
fields.description: 16..19: Size of DB in pages after commit (uint32 LE)

fields.name: FRAME_SEQ
fields.description: 20..23: Monotonic frame sequence counter in WAL (uint32 LE)

fields.name: CHECKSUM
fields.description: 24..27: CRC32 over header bytes 0..23 + 4096 page bytes (uint32 LE)
